name: Build Jarvis APK
on: [push, workflow_dispatch]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Create project from embedded zip
        run: |
          echo "" | base64 -d > JarvisApp.zip
          unzip -q JarvisApp.zip
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.7
      - run: gradle -p JarvisApp assembleDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jarvis-apk
          path: JarvisApp/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
